wiki.title: Mike Cierpiot
wiki.extract: Mike Cierpiot (born January 14, 1953) is an American politician. He is a member of the Missouri Senate from the 8th district, serving since 2018. He previously represented the 30th district in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2010 to 2018. He is a member of the Republican Party.
